{%- set currency = frappe.db.get_value("Company", doc.company, "default_currency") -%}
{{ _("Ref") }}: {{ doc.name }} {{ _("Date") }}: {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.letter_date) }}

{{ _("To") }},
{{ _("The Manager") }},
{{ doc.bank }}

{{ _("Dear Sir/Madam") }},

{{ _("Sub: Salary Transfer for the month of {0} {1}").format(_(doc.month), doc.year) }} {% if doc.ot_type == "OT Only" %}({{ _("Overtime Only") }}){% elif doc.ot_type == "Without OT" %}({{ _("Excluding Overtime") }}){% else %}({{ _("Including Overtime") }}){% endif %}

{{ _("Please debit our account with a sum of {0} ({1}) and credit the accounts of the {2} employees as per the attached WPS list.").format( "" + frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.total_amount, currency=currency) + "", frappe.utils.money_in_words(doc.total_amount, currency), doc.total_employees ) }}

{%- set loan_rows = doc.employees | selectattr("entry_type", "equalto", "OHB Loan") | list -%} {% if loan_rows %}

{{ _("This includes {0} towards OHB loan installments of {1} employee(s), to be credited to their OHB loan accounts.").format( "" + frappe.utils.fmt_money(loan_rows | sum(attribute="amount"), currency=currency) + "", loan_rows | length ) }}

{% endif %}

{{ _("Thanking you") }},

{{ _("Yours faithfully") }},
{{ _("For") }} {{ doc.company }}




{{ _("Authorised Signatory") }}
